about: The Deep paint decomposition set in the helper registry (electron/main/onnx/models.js fromSetCatalogue; docs/PLAN_SURFACE_PAINT.md SP2). Scumble's ONNX export of Marigold-IID-Lighting v1.1 (tools/deeppaint/export_onnx.py from prs-eth/marigold-iid-lighting-v1-1 @ 08c3930b, the fp16 variant, float32 in and out, the empty-prompt embedding baked into the UNet). Sizes and sha256 are the exported files' (docs/measurements/sp0_2026-11-13/sha256.txt). Hosted at huggingface.co/DenRakEiw/scumble-intrinsic-onnx with Marigold's licence and a README naming the changes (the licence's Section III, 4); `base` is that repo's resolve URL at the upload's commit, so the files and their sha256 stay what they are when the repo moves on.
label: Marigold IID Lighting
